properties.displayName: OT Boundary - Rare Outbound Destinations from OT Zone
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet" and DeviceAction =~ "allow"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Hits = count(), Sources = make_set(SourceIP, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DestinationIP, DestinationPort
| where Hits < 5
| order by LastSeen desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Destination IPs seen fewer than 5 times in 7 days in FortiGate allow logs from the OT zone. The OT zone should talk to a small, fixed set of destinations — anything rare deserves a look. Tune the source filter to the OT VLAN range during onboarding.
